provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Sylvavéryn is centered at 8.066809, -86.299300 under Theocracy, with 103,614,000 people across 10 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Sylvavéryn occupies 9,634,777.67 sq mi / 24,953,959.60 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 4.892301% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Partial forest and Beach and grass with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water and Treetops - treehouses. Population density is 4.152 people/sq km / 10.754 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Freeblade Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Asethyr, Thalunesh, Marduthor, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 8 recorded four-province geography group links, including 7 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Maxwell Velvetkey
npcs.description: Maxwell Velvetkey is a Grassland Dril'thar hotel steward whose politeness has survived more scandals than most buildings survive storms. At the Thalavaryn Guild Desk, he manages guests, accounts, room keys, sealed wings, and the delicate art of pretending not to hear nobles confess crimes through thin walls. The Choral Synod values him because a steward who remembers every arrival, meal, argument, and locked door can become more dangerous than any magistrate.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Thalavaryn is a Town in Sylvavéryn, under Theocracy, with moderate danger, Farming, Beach and grass with water, Grassland terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Grassland Dril’thar reads through the Dril'thar entry of the race compendium, within Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, marked by Bastveig. Amphibious Mystics of the Living Waters. Table cues: ancestral instincts, homeland pressure, and local reputation; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Maxwell Velvetkey knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Ishtaday.
Maxwell Velvetkey has a contact in Elarûneth who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Maxwell Velvetkey asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Maxwell Velvetkey's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Ozvald the Outrageous
npcs.description: Ozvald the Outrageous is a Hexblood stage mage trapped between performance, tragedy, and the desperate belief that the show must protect what is left of his people. At the Thalavaryn Workshop, he maintains illusions, stage wards, carnival horrors, and theatrical defenses for the Nefaric Veil while trying to keep cursed performers from being exterminated as monsters. He is funny, bitter, dangerous, and heartbreaking when the applause stops.
